sources.excerpt: The Shag MkII - Germanium Tone Bender Published on December 18, 2023 Stomp Under Foot fuzz pedal Mountain Music Exchange exclusive Mountain Music Exchange exclusive vintage enclosure vintage enclosure vintage enclosure vintage enclosure vintage enclosure vintage enclosure Information Stomp Under Foot The Stomp Under Foot The Shag MKII - Vintage Enclosure - Germanium Fuzz brings another of the large enclosure "what if" builds to this vintage-inspired line. The Shag features a Tonebender MKII circuit in a copy of the larger MKI enclosure, with a few modern upgrades including true-bypass. NOS Parts with NPN Germanium Transistors for that classic Germanium Fuzz tone. This three-transistor build delivers a fuzz circuit that hass a very rich, harmonic sound with a lot of gain. 9V Battery or 2.1 9V Adapter Only. Hand-wired and handmade by the one-man-band at Stomp Under Foot.
